video_title: Are the Warriors Wasting Steph's Final Years?

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are not hell-bent on wasting Steph Curry's final years
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that the Warriors are hell-bent on wasting the Steph Curry era.

text_blocks.speaker: Willard
text_blocks.text: I don't understand why they're so hell-bent on wasting the end of the Steph era.

text_blocks.speaker: Dibs
text_blocks.text: It's nonsense. I don't think that the Warriors are hell-bent on wasting the Steph Curry era. That is a bit of a cheap shot and it's short-sighted. You go back to last year at the deadline, you acquire Jimmy Butler. You traded a perfectly good Andrew Wiggins, healthy. You rolled the dice. That to me is not wasting the end of the Steph Curry era. Jimmy gets hurt, Moses gets hurt. If you wanted to waste the end of the Steph Curry era, well then you would have traded absolutely everything.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's continued high-level play demands an all-in approach
quotes.excerpt: You watch Steph Curry play and you're like, damn, he's still got it. So that means you've got to go all-in.
quotes.quote: There's people in the national media that get caught up in the romance of Steph Curry. You watch Steph Curry play and he played barely more than half the games last year, but you watch him play and you're like, damn, he's still got it. So that means you've got to go all-in. You've got to go all-in for Steph and I'm like, no, you really don't and you shouldn't. There is no all-in.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors have no interest in trading for Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.excerpt: They've got people's interest and the Warriors have no interest in dealing him.
quotes.quote: The same people are now excited about Jonathan Kuminga. He hasn't played an NBA game yet, but he's got people's interest and the Warriors have no interest in dealing him, as told to us by Ramona Shelburne. But there's two sides to that story. I'm sort of like, don't go all-in, but can you go some-in?

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo was a serious attempt
quotes.excerpt: We did three and a half shows on their pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: We were at Media Row here for the Super Bowl and we did three and a half shows if not more on their pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo. And it was four picks and two pick swaps and it would have been Jimmy Butler's contract and Draymond Green was thrown out there and there were rumors that they wanted to get Kevin Durant, but Kevin Durant didn't want to come. It's not like they're just sitting on their hands saying, well, we're hell-bent on wasting these last few years, Steph. I'm sorry.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green deal remains unsigned due to ongoing front-office work
quotes.excerpt: I take solace in the fact that the Draymond Green deal has not been announced or signed.
quotes.quote: I take solace in the fact that the Draymond Green deal has not been announced or signed. And that's not because I'm rooting for something bad to happen between Draymond and the Warriors. I just have to think that the only reason that they wouldn't have a deal done yet is because they're still working on some things. They're still working on some things. Maybe Trayce Jackson-Davis is about to be a Warrior. I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors are the biggest losers of the LeBron era
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say the Golden State Warriors, specifically.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say the Golden State Warriors, specifically. Steph Curry has my number one loser. It's his last chance for relevance and it's gone. I wrote down, it is the saddest older NBA superstar situation since 2011 Nash on the Suns and 2007 Garnett before he got traded to Boston. Of just guys now in purgatory who clearly have more to offer and it's not going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors were never interested in trading for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Why didn't they trade for Jaylen Brown? They weren't interested in him.
quotes.quote: There's a couple of pieces to this. One is, why didn't they trade for Jaylen Brown? They weren't interested in him. They weren't interested. They didn't even counter. And the irony is if they do that, I think LeBron goes there.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston would never trade an injured Jimmy Butler for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't believe that Boston was going to take back an injured Jimmy Butler.
quotes.quote: I don't believe that Boston was going to take back an injured Jimmy Butler, no matter how many picks you wanted to give them, and then they're just going to give you Jaylen Brown? No, they got Paul George, who you've mentioned before, he tends to be hurt sometimes, but he can play basketball on opening night. Jimmy can't.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' interest in Jaylen Brown and Jimmy Butler remains unclear
quotes.excerpt: I've seen tons of reports that are like, yeah, the Warriors didn't even engage on Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: I'm going to push back on his characterization that the Warriors weren't even interested. Maybe they weren't. I have no idea. I've seen tons of reports that are like, yeah, the Warriors didn't even engage on Jaylen Brown. And then I see reports where it's like, yeah, the Warriors called and the Boston wasn't interested in Jimmy Butler. Maybe that's true. Would there be a way to get them interested in it? Of course.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston would demand high-value assets for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: They probably would have asked for this year's pick, Jonathan Kuminga, and at least two other picks.
quotes.quote: They probably would have asked for this year's pick, Jonathan Kuminga, and at least two other picks if not three picks, because I think the Boston wants people who can play basketball. I think the Boston wants people who can play basketball. Maybe. And should the Warriors have done that? Should the Warriors have up that offer?

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' failed trade negotiations suggest they were working on other things
quotes.excerpt: Bill Simmons sounds like he knows something. He referred to it as the Warriors didn't even counter.
quotes.quote: Bill Simmons sounds like he knows something. He referred to it as the Warriors didn't even counter. They didn't counter. Well, that means there was an offer and the Warriors just hung up the phone and left. I wonder what the offer was. That does not mean that the Celtics were not interested in Jimmy Butler. That means the Warriors said, if you want to do that, here's how you get it done and the Warriors weren't interested in doing that.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics acquired significant assets for Paul George
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics got George and two firsts and two seconds.
quotes.quote: The Celtics got George and two firsts and two seconds. And the seconds are whatever. So I'm going to call that, yeah, two firsts and Paul George. But Bill Simmons is insinuating there was an offer. There was an offer made to the Warriors. Okay, and they didn't counter. Right, and if the offer was exactly, it's probably what they wound up taking from Philly, but the addition would be Jonathan Kuminga.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' trade offer for Jimmy Butler was insufficient
quotes.excerpt: No, Jonathan Kuminga and three firsts and two seconds and we'll take Jimmy Butler.
quotes.quote: No, Jonathan Kuminga and three firsts and two seconds and we'll take Jimmy Butler. I'm just trying to make it a comp to what they actually accepted. And I mean what would the counter be? The counter would be, we'll give you pods. We'll give you two picks and a pods.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors must beat Philadelphia's trade package for Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: You've got to be, you've got to be, Philly's picks.
quotes.quote: You've got to be, you've got to be, Philly's picks. So, if they gave them two ones, you've got to give them three. Jimmy Butler and three ones. Forget the Jonathan Kuminga part for a second. Would you have even done that? Jimmy Butler and three ones.

quotes.speaker: Dibs
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors should not have traded for Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: No, I would not have. Because you're going to get to a point here very soon.
quotes.quote: No, I would not have. Because you're going to get to a point here very soon and, you know, as Joe Lacob famously said, we're not doing the lottery. Well, you are and you just did and you might on the regular here if Steph Curry is no longer Steph Curry. And if you are a lottery team, you're going to want those lottery picks.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors front office is exploring options to maximize Steph's window
quotes.excerpt: I have full faith in this front office that they're doing everything they can.
quotes.quote: There's just been so much pessimism around the Warriors today with Bill Simmons and then driving in on my way to work on the morning roast, callers super negative, calling for Joe Lacob and Mike Dunleavy's heads, which is all just makes me cringe. And you know, like, I have full faith in this front office that they're doing everything they can to to explore these different options to maximize Steph's window without throwing away the future.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' potential starting five with Jimmy Butler is intriguing
quotes.excerpt: I'm actually a little bit more optimistic than I sense from most.
quotes.quote: I'm actually a little bit more optimistic than I sense from most and you guys because one thing is Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porzingis have never stepped foot on a on a court on the same team together yet. And so if you tell me that we have Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Kristaps Porzingis, Jimmy Butler and say whoever to fill out that fifth spot, I I think that's an intriguing five.

quotes.speaker: Willard
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' health concerns and Rick Celebrini's track record
quotes.excerpt: We know Rick Celebrini. We know what the Warriors do when somebody comes back.
quotes.quote: I think Morgan, when you say I'm assuming health, we can already to a degree assume lack of health, at least for half the season. You know what I mean? And then we know Rick Celebrini. We know what the Warriors do when somebody comes back. They don't play all the games for a while.
